nationalCeiling.method: Triangulate gov canonical (606 live / 693 2018 archive) against the largest aggregators (mikve.net ~900 Israel, mikveh.co.il women 1017+men 155+vessels 298 incl. diaspora, Chabad ~300) and account for de-duplication + facility types.
nationalCeiling.currentVsCeiling: Project has 531 now; gov-complete alone reaches ~606-693; realistic reachable ceiling after integrating the verified sources above ≈ 1,300-1,600 (all types), i.e. roughly DOUBLE the gov dataset, the increment coming from men's + vessel (כלים) mikvahs, Chabad/small-settlement mikvahs, and yishuvim absent from gov.
nationalCeiling.caveat: Aggregator counts overlap heavily with each other and with gov; net-new requires cross-source dedup (coords where available, else city+name+phone). Licensing: every aggregator/NGO is 'all rights reserved' → permission required; only data.gov.il(2018), Tel-Aviv GIS, OSM, Wikidata are openly licensed.
